asset.name: Skeleton
asset.description: The structure-aware loading placeholder that reserves the final layout and can represent text, media, avatars, rows, and custom shapes.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.

rationale: A skeleton that does not match the layout it replaces causes the shift it exists to prevent, which is why this is structure-aware rather than a generic shimmer block.
